study: round two of user-authorized MA+price/volume study
clue: synchronous widening may chase overheated prices; test price/volume/volatility conditions

candidate_formulas.widen_no_chase: joint MA widening; close no more than 0.5 ATR14 above MA5
candidate_formulas.widen_upper_range: joint MA widening; close in top 30% of recent 20-bar range
candidate_formulas.widen_breakout20: joint MA widening; close above prior 20-bar high
candidate_formulas.widen_inside_high20: joint MA widening; close at or below prior 20-bar high
candidate_formulas.widen_green_body: joint MA widening weighted by positive same-day close-open body / ATR14
candidate_formulas.widen_red_body: joint MA widening weighted by negative same-day close-open body / ATR14
candidate_formulas.widen_volume_up: joint MA widening weighted by volume / 20-bar average above one
candidate_formulas.widen_volume_down: joint MA widening weighted by volume / 20-bar average below one
candidate_formulas.widen_atr_up: joint MA widening weighted by ATR5 / ATR20 above one
candidate_formulas.widen_atr_down: joint MA widening weighted by ATR5 / ATR20 below one
candidate_formulas.widen_gap_up: joint MA widening weighted by t-open / previous close positive gap
candidate_formulas.widen_gap_down: joint MA widening weighted by t-open / previous close negative gap

data_and_return_rules: identical to round one; historical CSI300 exploration only
primary: own five-day mean return and up rate; 0.3% cost sensitivity
auxiliary: same-day cohort edge and rank IC; not vetoes
historical_screen: three eras each >=20 signal dates, >=200 positions, own mean >0.3%
